faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AYCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the AYCL Asst. Officer Gr. I / Dy. Officer (Sales & Marketing for APC and/or WPC Equipment & Project) posts is 27 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Civil Engineering to be eligible for the Asst. Officer Gr. I / Dy. Officer position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this recruitment is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for AYCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 43893 to Rs. 47085 per month, along with conveyance and mobile reimbursement.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Asst. Officer Gr. I / Dy. Officer (Sales & Marketing for APC and/or WPC Equipment & Project).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted online.

faq.question: Q9. In which state is this job located?
faq.answer: This job opportunity is located in West Bengal, specifically in Kalyani.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the employment?
faq.answer: The employment for this post is contractual.
